newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prices rise, volume firms.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prices rise, volume firms.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose to 1,658 kilos on Monday from Friday's 970 kilos as traders took up positions expecting further price rises, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $328.60 an ounce and 1,641,000 lira per gram, compared to $324.00 and 1,617,500 lira on Friday, following higher levels on European markets.
"The rising prices on the market encouraged buying from traders expecting the trend to continue, though these feelings weakened towards the end of the day," one dealer said.
The lira fell to 155,240 to the dollar versus 154,620 on Friday, boosting gold's rise in lira terms.
Almost all the day's trade -- 1,644 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 57.8 percent conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
